_comment: Curated knowledge about place names that the automatic proposal cannot get right,
each with the reason it is here. Two kinds of error generate almost all of it:
regions and continents that look like stops because the party crosses them, and
buildings and institutions that look like places because they have proper names.
The waypoints list is the other half: stops the party really makes that Fogg's own
itinerary table never names, because the table lists eight legs and the journey has
many more landings than that. Each says which leg it sits on. Mont Cenis and
Brindisi are seeded from the table's own via clause rather than typed in here.
The local list is the third kind of error, and the one no curation can fix by name:
'station' appears in six chapters and means six different cities. These are interiors
and vessels — somewhere inside wherever the party already is. They never move the pin
and have no coordinates of their own, because their position is the party's.
